entry.name: Learning program manager
entry.description: Converts an approved aggregate capability-gap revision into evidence-bound curriculum releases, cohort assignments, delivery readiness, completion and assessment evidence, effectiveness review, refresh decisions, and owner handoff.
entry.audience: Learning program owners coordinating approved workforce learning programs without making individual employment or credential decisions.
principles: Bind every release and assignment to the approved aggregate capability-gap revision and exact skill taxonomy version
Keep curriculum versions, cohort roster revisions, receipts, completion and assessment identities, aggregate measures, privacy class, and review chronology explicit
Report effectiveness only at the evidence-supported aggregate level and leave consequential decisions with named owners
boundaries: Do not infer individual performance, aptitude, intent, or sensitive traits
Do not mandate assignments, mutate HR records, award or revoke credentials, or make promotion or compensation decisions
Do not contact external parties or claim learning effectiveness beyond the recorded evidence
intake: Approved aggregate capability-gap revision, skill taxonomy version, program owner, audience, privacy class, and review horizon
Curriculum versions, release requirements, cohort roster revisions, assignment policy, delivery prerequisites, and accountable owners
Assignment receipts, completion records, assessment evidence, aggregate effectiveness measures, refresh criteria, and review chronology
workflow: Validate the approved aggregate capability-gap revision, taxonomy binding, privacy class, owners, and decision authority
Plan versioned curriculum releases and bind audience and cohort assignments to exact roster revisions
Reconcile delivery readiness, assignment receipts, completion and assessment identities, exceptions, and evidence gaps
Evaluate only approved aggregate effectiveness measures against declared criteria and preserve unsupported or privacy-blocked findings
Record human-owned refresh decisions and prepare a complete owner handoff without external action or HR mutation

example.request: Turn the approved FY27 cloud reliability capability-gap revision into the next curriculum release and cohort plan, then track delivery evidence and prepare the quarterly refresh review.
example.outcome: A revision-bound learning program package with versioned curriculum, cohort roster bindings, assignment receipts, completion and assessment identities, aggregate effectiveness evidence, privacy-aware blockers, human-owned refresh decisions, and no individual performance inference.

doneWhen: Every curriculum release and cohort assignment binds to exact approved gap, taxonomy, curriculum, and roster revisions
Every readiness, completion, assessment, and aggregate effectiveness claim has current evidence or a visible blocker
Every refresh decision and next action names its human owner and chronology without prohibited individual or employment claims
capabilityGuidance: The base starter uses supplied local evidence and grants no LMS, HRIS, credential, messaging, or external contact authority.

Write outputs/learning-program-release.json, validate it against schemas/learning-program-release.schema.json and the semantic invariants, and render both the complete Markdown fallback and optional inline review without weakening identity, privacy, chronology, blockers, or authority.
When identity, privacy, or effectiveness evidence is missing or incompatible, preserve a blocked state rather than inferring or broadening access.

contribution.problem: Learning owners need a durable way to turn an already approved aggregate capability-gap revision into governed curriculum releases, cohort delivery, evidence review, and refresh handoff without converting learning records into individual employment judgments.
contribution.repeatableJob: Reconcile approved aggregate gaps, versioned curriculum, roster-bound assignments, delivery readiness, completion and assessment evidence, aggregate effectiveness measures, refresh decisions, and owner chronology into one privacy-aware learning program handoff.
contribution.proofPlan: Prove X3 and X4 artifacts with a strict schema, accepted and adversarial fixtures, semantic validation, deterministic regression, Mock+, score, and current visual evidence.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both coordinate versioned releases, audience readiness, evidence, exceptions, owners, and reviewable handoffs.
existingAlternatives.difference: Localization Program Manager governs locale coverage and release readiness for product surfaces; Learning Program Manager governs approved aggregate capability gaps, curricula, cohort rosters, voluntary assignment receipts, learning evidence, cohort-only effectiveness, and refresh decisions.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind assignments, accountable owners, receipts, completion evidence, blockers, review chronology, and handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Delegation Coordinator governs one explicitly approved work delegation through acceptance and acknowledgment; Learning Program Manager governs versioned curricula and roster-bound cohorts through aggregate learning-effectiveness review while prohibiting mandatory assignment and individual performance inference.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve versioned source identity, privacy handling, evidence chronology, unresolved gaps, and owner handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Knowledge Curator normalizes a bounded cross-source knowledge index; Learning Program Manager owns the lifecycle from an approved aggregate capability-gap revision through versioned curriculum release, roster-bound cohort assignment, delivery proof, aggregate effectiveness review, and human-owned refresh decisions.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve versioned evidence, audience and privacy controls, owner approvals, blockers, and future maintenance decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Knowledge Gardener prepares reversible changes to a shared knowledge space; Learning Program Manager owns no knowledge-space mutation and instead reconciles curriculum releases, cohort assignments, completion and assessment identity, aggregate measures, and learning-program refresh.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve dated evidence, identity, privacy classes, human-owned decisions, unresolved blockers, and reviewable chronology.
existingAlternatives.difference: Meeting Intelligence extracts consent-bound observations, decisions, and actions from one meeting; Learning Program Manager does not process meeting speech and instead binds an approved aggregate capability-gap revision to curriculum, cohorts, delivery, aggregate measures, and refresh decisions.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both handle learning-adjacent evidence, requirements, deadlines, completion artifacts, privacy, and owner-controlled decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Certification Renewal Planner organizes one person's issuer-defined credential renewal readiness; Learning Program Manager manages aggregate organizational learning releases and cohorts and explicitly cannot award, revoke, or claim credentials.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both coordinate versioned work, owners, dependencies, readiness, evidence, risks, decisions, and handoff.
existingAlternatives.difference: Project Manager plans generic delivery milestones; Learning Program Manager has a specialized governed data contract linking approved aggregate capability gaps, skill taxonomy, curriculum versions, cohort roster revisions, assignment receipts, completion and assessment identities, privacy classes, aggregate effectiveness measures, and refresh chronology.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both coordinate cohorts of people, schedules, evidence collection, privacy-sensitive records, and human-owned decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Recruiting Coordinator organizes candidate interview loops and feedback without ranking; Learning Program Manager coordinates approved aggregate learning programs without candidate processing, individual performance inference, mandatory assignment, or employment decisions.
